source: Carlo Gavazzi EM24 DIN Modbus protocol. Signed 32-bit measurements. Function 0x03 (holding) — EM24 also answers 0x04. Over RS485 → use a Modbus-TCP gateway, or modbusMeter via serial in a later RTU driver.
wordSwapNote: EM24 stores 32-bit values most-significant-word first (big-endian). If powers/energy read as absurd values, the unit is word-swapped → set wordSwap:true.
note: W_sys sign convention: positive = import (consumption), negative = export. The dashboard's net_flow is derived backend-side; expose both output_kw (signed) and consumption_kw so the aggregator can place it. For a pure load node set type:LOAD in config.
